title: Senior Backend Engineer - Commercial Systems and Intelligence

description: Naschen klingt für viele nach schlechtem Gewissen. Bei uns nicht. Jede dieser Nachrichten ist ein Moment, in dem wir jemanden für gesunden Genuss begeistern können — auch die, die mit Ärger anfängt. Deine Nordstern-Metriken: Lösungszeit und Kundenzufriedenheit. Ausgangslage Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein Kundenservice-Team. Der Service hängt aktuell an einer Person, die ihn neben Auftragsbearbeitung und Verwaltung mitmacht. Das heißt für dich: Du wirst eingearbeitet, aber du bist nach wenigen Wochen die Person, die den Posteingang verantwortet. Und du verantwortest mehr als das Beantworten - du entwickelst unseren Kundenservice weiter: Prozesse, Antwortstandards, unser internes Wiki und das Help Center. Wer eine Frage zum fünften Mal beantwortet, ohne sich zu fragen warum, ist in dieser Rolle falsch. Aufgaben Du beantwortest Kundenanfragen per Mail, Telefon und Social Media in unserem Ticketing-System - mit klarer Priorität: lieferkritische Anliegen zuerst, immer, besonders montagfrüh Du entscheidest Kulanz selbst bis zu einem festgelegten Betrag. Wir suchen die beste Lösung für die Kundin, nicht die günstigste für uns - und du setzt das um, ohne für jede Erstattung zu fragen Du betreust unsere Community auf unseren Brand-Kanälen (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest): Kommentare und Nachrichten, nach unseren Tonalitäts-Guidelines. description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! YOUR MISSION Make sure UK Leasing always has the best-priced, best-covered deals in the market, so our sales team can draw more leads and convert more of them. This means owning the overall competitiveness of our marketplace, the deals every partner lists on it as well as Leasey's own, not just our own broker's position. You are the pricing engine behind the offer set: you find where we are missing competitive supply, own the ratebooks that power the marketplace, keep pricing accurate day to day, and guide Procurement and the Marketplace commercial team on where to find deals and at what price. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Analyse funder ratebooks and the Carwow marketplace to identify demand-supply whitespace, and guide the Procurement team on where to focus their supply-finding and at what price points. Own and manage all ratebooks, including building custom ratebooks where a supplier does not provide one, and continually improving the efficiency of that process. Manage ratebook uploads to the Carwow marketplace and third-party aggregators. Own pricing accuracy on a daily basis, removing deals and capping leads where necessary. Act as the in-office pricing expert and advisor to Procurement when they uncover supply opportunities, such as dealer finance deals or commitment batches. Build the models and tooling, using AI where it helps, that make pricing and the wider commercial team faster and more accurate. Own the monitoring of supply and deal competitiveness across the whole Carwow marketplace, tracked by brand, model, category and partner. This covers the overall competitiveness of the deals on our marketplace, not only Leasey's own position. Work with the Marketplace commercial team to make sure we are sourcing the best supply from our broker partners, using the whitespace and competitiveness analysis to steer what we ask partners for. Track competitor pricing and deal scores across the market, and turn the picture into clear guidance and priorities for both Procurement and Marketplace. KEY REQUIREMENTS Strong analytical skills. Expert in Excel or Sheets, comfortable with BI tooling (Looker, Power BI) and ideally SQL. Comfortable building models and tooling, and adept at using AI tools such as Claude and Cursor to work faster and more accurately. A good grasp of vehicle leasing economics: how a monthly rental is built from residual value, cost of funds, on-the-road price, VAT and commission, and how ratebooks work. We will support the right person in deepening this. High attention to detail and a bias for accuracy, with the discipline to own a daily operational process where errors are visible to Sales and customers. Commercially minded and confident advising a Procurement team, able to turn analysis into clear, actionable recommendations. Understanding of how marketplaces work, including the interplay of demand and supply liquidity (desirable). Experience in vehicle leasing, motor finance, or another data-rich commercial or pricing environment (desirable). description: Who are we At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel. By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost. Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control. Location While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain. This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms.   About the Team Our Finance team is the backbone of Lokalise's financial operations—ensuring accuracy, compliance, and control as we scale. Reporting to the Financial Controller and working closely with FP&A, you will step into a broad, hands-on role. You will own month-end close and balance sheet integrity across our global entities while acting as the primary internal liaison for our external accounting, payroll, and EOR providers. Additionally, you will champion our finance automation program, transitioning the team from manual workflows to highly scalable, controlled processes.   What You Will Do Own the month-end close across multiple entities, managing journals, accruals, reconciliations, and reporting strictly to the group timetable. Own balance sheet integrity, with a specific focus on payroll and employment costs. Act as the internal client for outsourced accounting, payroll, and EOR platforms. Review output, hold them to SLAs, and review/approve payroll across our US, UK, Spanish, Latvian, and EOR entities to meet statutory deadlines. Prepare and post payroll/employment cost journals into the ERP, ensuring data integrity between our HRIS and payroll providers. Provide detailed analysis and actionable commentary on Operating Expenses and other critical areas of the P&L. Lead the charge on documenting and improving workflows. You will transition manual reviews into risk-based, threshold-driven controls. Support annual audits and statutory reporting alongside our auditors and outsourced providers.   What You Must Have 5+ years in a hands-on accounting role within a SaaS or tech company, including payroll accounting processes (journals, accruals, and control account reconciliations), month-end close, and balance sheet reconciliations across multiple entities. Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA, or equivalent), or qualified by extensive relevant experience. Experience acting as the internal client for external accounting, payroll, or EOR providers — reviewing their output and holding them accountable for accuracy and compliance.
